Create ONE landscape 1536x1024 PNG 3-COLUMN x 2-ROW character sheet, exactly SIX NEW UNIQUE KFB SLOPS: absurd explorers, surreal pioneers, weird researchers, jungle / ancient pyramid / alien planet expedition VIBES ONLY. NO scenelets or scenery. Exactly TWO female-read characters (slots2 and5). All six full standalone continuous FOOTLESS charcoal-deep-violet INK BLOB MONSTERS. Strict separate cells, generous empty transparent gutters and safe margins, entire figures and props, no clipping/touching. TRUE transparent alpha PNG, no colored background, no gradient or floor or shadow disc, no checkerboard bitmap.
The attached ORIGINALS are actual STYLE REFERENCES, not edit targets: image1 authority for thick rich softly rounded dark goo splats, modeled lids and thick lips, irregular huge teeth, tactile plasticine; image2 for beautifully hand-modeled bold costume and prop craft. Do not copy uniform angry faces, glowing eyeballs or background. WHITE/ivory eyeballs, RED IRIS, BLACK PUPIL for all visible eyes; chunky expressive soft eyelids. Rich sculpted handmade clay, tactile fingerprints, rounded imperfect contours, subtle dark violet sheen, soft upper-left light. Monstrous charming cartoon physicality, not generic cute animation studio mascots. Differentiate silhouette, gaze, mouth action, posture and age before costume. 1-2 strong readable props per actor; beautiful chunky clay brass, wood, glass, fabric and alien organic material. Immediate bodily physical relation, not complicated conceptual riddles. Adventure absurdity via character and bold strange finds. Partial garments preserve complete goo body, no humans/legs/feet.
TOP LEFT: stout wide jungle pathfinder, lumpy four-lobed squat splat, battered olive pith helmet with one absurdly huge leaf stuck in brim, only short khaki collar/scarf. Suspicious one-eye squint, other eye looking left, compressed crooked underbite with three uneven teeth. Grips a thick curved expedition machete low at side and a small bunch of very large strange purple bananas with a single peel curling like a tentacle. Grizzled stubborn physical presence.
TOP CENTER: FEMALE-READ exuberant pyramid archaeologist, taller leaning pear silhouette with long curling goo crest, burnt-coral tied headscarf and small dusty sand-colored neckerchief. Wide delighted red-pupilled eyes, big asymmetrical open tooth grin, subtle lashes. One hand gently brushes a chunky jade scarab artifact in her other palm with a fat worn excavation brush; scarab has oversized rounded wings and gold insets. Beautiful tangible clay object, no hieroglyph text or floating symbols.
TOP RIGHT: very old desert surveyor, low sagging puddle shape, floppy faded indigo sunhat, little round brass spectacles resting low beneath enormous drooping lids, mouth a bored lopsided sigh with single long tooth. Both goo hands struggle to hold a huge unfurled parchment map curling vigorously back around his goo sides; one large rounded brass compass hangs off map edge. No readable writing or map labels, parchment curls do the physical cartoon work. Pyramids implied only by expedition kit.
BOTTOM LEFT: alien-planet botanical pioneer, tall narrow springy goo with asymmetric upper lobes and brass aviator goggles on forehead, faded mustard short shoulder cape. Eyes crossed toward a giant bulbous teal alien mushroom he's holding at nose height; nose absent, amused astonished O-shaped mouth with two lower teeth. A short-handled rounded field trowel in other hand; mushroom thick coral-pink gills and fat cream stem, three large lilac spots, strange fleshy clay craft. No background growth/scenery, single specimen prop.
BOTTOM CENTER: FEMALE-READ skeptical xenobiologist, compact broad sideways-leaning ink splat, weathered teal field hood pushed back around one soft curled goo quiff, two tiny modeled lashes. Half-lidded unimpressed red gaze, crooked CLOSED smile with one snaggle fang. Holds a chunky round glass specimen jar against belly; inside one simple lime-green slug with absurdly big antenna bulbs presses its face to glass; other hand raises a bold brass magnifier at jar. Round heavy glass translated into clay language, uncluttered readable silhouette. No lab coat torso.
BOTTOM RIGHT: manic veteran expedition inventor, big nearly spherical splat with small drooping bottom lobes, one tall goo curl, worn reddish leather aviator cap and small scratched brass monocle. One eye wide and one narrowed, huge wild lopsided laugh with uneven teeth and pink tongue. Cradles a chunky retro brass field scanner like a concertina: round analog dial (no numbers), one broad flared sensing horn and short thick side handle. One hand turns a big red winding crank. Worn 1930s retro-sci-fi device, only a few large shapes, no cables clutter, no lightning or floating icons.
All six visibly separate personalities, silhouettes and mouth configurations. Weirdness must remain tactile, primal, cartoony and readable, NOT ornate intellectual puzzles. Color accents olive, coral, jade, brass, mustard, teal. No text, labels, typography, floor, environment, mini-diorama, scenic bases or shadows. EXACTLY SIX whole ink monsters on transparent background.
